title: How does power reach the wheels?
objectives: Learn the gestures: explode, trace, unplug, replug, collapse.
See how one missing connection stops everything after it.

steps.caption: This is a simplified EV drivetrain, a teaching model and not a real car's internals. Press Explode to open it up, or pinch with both hands and pull apart.
steps.hint: Press Explode. You can also pinch with both hands and pull them apart.

steps.caption: Press Trace to follow power from the battery to the wheels.
steps.hint: The Trace button is in the panel next to you.

steps.caption: Unplug the cable between the inverter and the motor.
steps.hint: Select the highlighted cable, then press Unplug.

on_enter.text: This cable carries AC power to the motor.

steps.caption: Before you look: point at the first part that stops.
steps.hint: Which part was the cable feeding?

feedback.correct: Right. The motor stops first, and everything after it stops too.
feedback.incorrect: Not quite. The motor stops first because it lost its power, and everything after it stops too.

steps.caption: No power reaches the motor, so nothing downstream turns. This is the teaching model's rule, not a measurement.
Plug the cable back into the right socket.
steps.hint: The cable came from the inverter. Which part needs AC power?

steps.caption: Power flows again. Press Collapse to close it up, or push your hands together. Next: the same moves on a real codebase.
steps.hint: Press Collapse. You can also bring your hands together.
